title: 34th INTERNATIONAL KARSTOLOGICAL SCHOOL “CLASSICAL KARST”
excerpt: The 34th International Karstological School continues a tradition of scientific exchange and fieldwork in Classical Karst.
content:
Since 1993, the International Karstological School “Classical Karst” has brought together early-career and established karst researchers in Postojna. Lectures, posters and field excursions connect current science with the landscapes and caves of Classical Karst.

The 34th edition continues this tradition with a new highlighted theme and programme taking shape.

title: About the school
excerpt: Each edition gathers lectures, posters and fieldwork around a question shaping contemporary karst research.
content:
34th edition · In preparation

A new highlighted topic

Each edition gathers lectures, posters and fieldwork around a question shaping contemporary karst research.

Purpose of the school

IKS Classical Karst creates a meeting place for early-career and established karst researchers from around the world. Participants share new work through lectures and posters, exchange ideas across disciplines and experience research questions directly in the field.

Afternoon and full-day excursions connect each edition’s scientific topic with key sites of Classical Karst. The final excursion traditionally presents the wider karst landscape and its most important features.

title: Programme
excerpt: Lectures, poster sessions and field excursions shape the 34th school week.
content:
34th edition · In preparation

A week of science and fieldwork

Lectures, poster sessions and field excursions form the programme of the 34th edition.

Scientific sessions alternate with afternoon and full-day field excursions through Classical Karst.

title: Places to eat
excerpt: Restaurants, pizzerias and daily meals within easy reach of the school venues in Postojna.
content:
(1) Proteus Restaurant
Restaurant with all sorts of food and a daily menu. On Postojna’s main square, next to the Institute.

(2) Bar Bor
Traditional local daily meals. Good and cheap. On the corner of Postojna’s main square; across the street from the Hotel Kras.

(3) Pizzeria Čuk
Located in the Sport Park. Although known as pizzeria, they also serve good pasta and other food, including salad bar and a daily menu.

(4) Pizzeria Minutka
Pizzeria with other items, “Balkan” food, and a daily menu.

(5) Štorja pod stopnicami
Restaurant with very diverse and tasty food.

title: 34. MEDNARODNA KRASOSLOVNA ŠOLA
excerpt: 34. Mednarodna krasoslovna šola nadaljuje tradicijo znanstvene izmenjave in terenskega dela na Klasičnem krasu.
content:
Mednarodna krasoslovna šola »Klasični kras« od leta 1993 v Postojni povezuje mlade in uveljavljene raziskovalce krasa. Predavanja, predstavitve plakatov in terenske ekskurzije povezujejo sodobno krasoslovje s pokrajino in jamami Klasičnega krasa.

34. izvedba nadaljuje to tradicijo z novo vodilno temo in programom v nastajanju.

title: O šoli
excerpt: Vsaka izvedba poveže predavanja, plakate in terensko delo okoli vprašanja, ki zaznamuje sodobno krasoslovje.
content:
34. izvedba · V pripravi

Nova vodilna tema

Vsaka izvedba poveže predavanja, plakate in terensko delo okoli vprašanja, ki zaznamuje sodobno krasoslovje.

Namen šole

MKŠ Klasični kras je stičišče mladih in uveljavljenih raziskovalcev krasa z vsega sveta. Udeleženci predstavljajo nove raziskave v obliki predavanj in plakatov, izmenjujejo znanje med različnimi področji ter raziskovalna vprašanja spoznavajo neposredno na terenu.

Popoldanske in celodnevne ekskurzije vsakoletno vodilno temo povežejo s ključnimi območji Klasičnega krasa. Zadnja ekskurzija je tradicionalno namenjena širši predstavitvi kraške pokrajine in njenih najpomembnejših značilnosti.

excerpt: Predavanja, predstavitve plakatov in terenske ekskurzije oblikujejo teden 34. krasoslovne šole.
